notes: Hard. Dependent_stages=2: the emulated machine must actually be running before the pidfile/cmdline/live-status chain is coherent, and teardown must precede every (re)boot — a broken earlier stage is only diagnosable by inspecting process/listener state. tool_breadth=3 spans qemu-system process management (TCG, -vnc :N display arithmetic 5900+N, -display none/-nic none, no -kernel firmware stage), daemonised background services with pidfiles, idempotent config-driven restart, busybox httpd with a CGI live-status endpoint, and listener-table (ss/netstat) + RFB protocol level verification. reasoning_depth=2: keeping VNC reachable under -display none without a guest kernel, and wiring a CGI endpoint that reflects the live qemu pid at request time rather than a canned answer. interaction_statefulness=3: background VM/web coherence must survive idempotent re-runs across the default and hidden configs (different display/port/paths/titles/markers/mem). hidden_case_generalization=2: three hidden configs re-drive launch.sh and every assertion follows the config. quantitative_correctness=2: exact ports, exact cmdline flags, exact live fields. Covers C-d7f631d3 (VNC on display one + web server on standard port) via netstat/ss listener asserts plus RFB/HTTP/live-status probes.
